name: 6.1 The Central Limit Theorem for Sample Means
_note: Built 2026-08-12. Three reuses (q2-x-bar-conditions, q4-x-bar-probability, q5-clt-single-vs-sample - all health=ok, never filed) plus seven authored (q7-x-bar-notation, q8-standard-error, q9-x-bar-probability-between, q10-x-bar-percentile, q11-se-half-and-quarter, q12-which-distribution, pre-frq-grade-a-clt-reasoning) = ten. Points 10+10+10+10+10+10+10+9+9+12 = 100. BookSHelf 6.1 is the CLT for sample means: bar(X) ~ N(mu, sigma/sqrt(n)), the standard error, z = (bar(x)-mu)/SE, probabilities and percentiles for a sample mean. Pre-FRQ mirrors frq/sampling-distributions/q1-sampling-distribution-reasoning.php; dropped category is CONDITIONS FOR CLT (the mirror's second rubric line - a plausible answer names the parameter and statistic and computes the standard error without ever verifying the sampling distribution is approximately normal).
